title: Run an independent installed development governance pilot

requirement.summary: Validate the corrected product direction from an exact locally built wheel in an independent Git repository, including real coding-agent context consumption and the complete guided development governance loop.

objective.rationale: An installed independent-repository pilot is required before treating the source implementation as a downloadable development-governance product.

goal: Build and install the exact development wheel in isolation, govern one small independent-repository coding task end to end, and record observed friction and honest claim limits.
non_goals: Do not publish a package, GitHub Release, tag, commit, push, pull request, deployment, or external telemetry event.
Do not modify AI Radar, NYC, GLAP, or another existing consumer repository.
Do not present one internal coding-agent run as uncoached human validation, general effectiveness, causal benefit, or cross-platform proof.
Do not add hooks, a daemon, unattended approval, automatic governance mutation, or a combined CI/development history contract.
acceptance_signals: An exact wheel is built from the current source, identified by filename and SHA-256, and installed with --no-deps into a fresh isolated environment.

A fresh independent Git repository with no AI Radar dependency completes start, context routing, an in-scope coding-agent edit, check, fresh finish, and static Monitor generation using the installed package.
The coding agent records which selected constraints it read, which it followed, whether unrelated governance was omitted, and any context or workflow friction.
The Monitor contains the expected task start, scope, validation, and completion observations while retaining partial-history and consumption claim limits.
The pilot record distinguishes automated plumbing evidence, internal coding-agent observation, and claims that remain unknown.
The complete source suite and repository governance checks pass after documentation updates.

items: A source-built wheel could be confused with the published stable release because version promotion is intentionally deferred.
An internal agent-operated pilot could be overstated as independent human evidence.
Temporary repository or validation output could accidentally be persisted into the product repository.

stop_conditions: Stop if installation needs an unreviewed network dependency or external publication.
Stop if the pilot cannot identify the exact wheel independently of its displayed package version.
Stop if the coding task requires edits outside the disposable independent repository or its admitted path scope.
Stop if the pilot would require bypassing a failed governance check or weakening an existing test.

decision.rationale: The user explicitly authorized the recommended independent installed-build pilot after reviewing the current project state.
